title: Attribution graph: layered nodes over a token row with weighted mauve edges (the strongest in maroon), layer labels, token tiles, an output tile and a two-entry legend with a numbered caption
use: The path from input tokens to an output through active features: layers (2-4) and cols (3-5) set the grid, seed the active nodes and edge weights.

seed.note: seed of the active nodes and weights

fig_title.default: 归因图：从输入词到输出的激活路径

layer_{i}.note: label of layer i, bottom up

legend_text_1.default: 特征没能解释的部分用菱形节点补回，使替代模型的输出和原模型一致。

legend_text_2.default: 线越粗，上游特征对下游的因果贡献越大，最粗的边用深色标出。

caption.default: 对输入“利率 下调 之后 波动”追踪出的归因图（示意）。节点是特征，边是因果贡献；示例数据。

relations: Graph area x 192-1056, y 168-656: layer rows evenly spaced bottom up, four 11-unit-radius nodes per token and layer at 36-unit steps, beige with a 2-unit stone outline when inactive and maroon when active; edges are vertical cubic curves between active nodes (width 1.2 + 3.4 x weight, opacity by weight), thin stone edges run from the tokens to the first layer, the output tile sits top right.
Legend at x 1180, 324 units wide: a maroon diamond with a bold title and up to four 16-unit lines, then a mauve line sample with its title and text; the caption sits at y 758.
decoration: Nodes, edges and tiles are decoration (the shapes are plain geometry the static check measures for the accent budget); layer labels, tokens, output, legend and caption are slots.

provenance.corpus: research-paper kit (examples/circuits-paper-kit): our own original interactive paper page in the circuits-paper grammar; all copy, features and numbers are labelled samples
provenance.experiment: styles/circuits-paper/style.json provenance (three public reference pages measured privately in Chrome on 2026-11-21; never shipped)
provenance.method: The reference attribution-graph figure's grammar (beige and maroon nodes in layers over a token row, weighted mauve edges, a legend with a diamond and a line sample) drawn from a seed.
measured: Attribution graph: circles filled #F6F6F3 with a 2 px #B8B6AD outline, active #633636, edges #C46686 0.5-3 px, token tiles #E6E3D6 with mono 17 px, error nodes as diamonds.
Template: 2-4 layers x 3-5 columns x 50 seeds, light and dark pass.
